title: "Hastings: school finances"
subtitle: "Reserves, in-year balances, income and the spread of schools' finances in Hastings' state primary and secondary schools, against England, the region and the rest of Sussex."
---

<!-- Generated from templates/finance_area.qmd by R/45_finance_pages.R: edit the template, not this file. -->

```{r setup}
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "site_helpers.R"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
AREA <- "Hastings"; LEVEL <- "District"; POSS <- "Hastings'"
A <- readRDS(here::here("data", "area_finance.rds"))
S <- A$stats; U <- A$units
REGION <- U[level == "Authority" & unit == (if (LEVEL == "District") U[level == "District" & unit == AREA, parent] else AREA), parent]
PARENT <- if (LEVEL == "District") U[level == "District" & unit == AREA, parent] else NA
SUSSEX <- c("Brighton and Hove", "East Sussex", "West Sussex")
COMP <- unique(na.omit(c(if (LEVEL == "District") PARENT, setdiff(SUSSEX, c(AREA, PARENT)))))
LAT_M <- A$latest[["Maintained"]]; LAT_A <- A$latest[["Academy"]]
sel <- function(u, l) S[unit == u & level == l]
area <- sel(AREA, LEVEL); eng <- sel("England", "England"); reg <- sel(REGION, "Region")
cmp <- rbindlist(lapply(COMP, function(u) sel(u, "Authority")))
lines <- rbind(area[, who := AREA], eng[, who := "England"], reg[, who := REGION], cmp[, who := unit])
lines[, who := factor(who, unique(c(AREA, "England", REGION, COMP)))]
# Colour follows the area across pages: the page's own area dark purple with points; England
# dashed ink; the region dotted grey; Brighton and Hove blue, East Sussex bright purple, West
# Sussex mid purple (long dashes, to keep it apart from East Sussex).
FIXED <- c("Brighton and Hove" = BLUE, "East Sussex" = BPURPLE, "West Sussex" = MPURPLE)
WHO_COL <- setNames(ifelse(levels(lines$who) == AREA, DPURPLE, ifelse(levels(lines$who) == "England", INK,
  ifelse(levels(lines$who) %in% names(FIXED), FIXED[levels(lines$who)], GREY))), levels(lines$who))
WHO_LT <- setNames(ifelse(levels(lines$who) == AREA, "solid", ifelse(levels(lines$who) == "England", "dashed",
  ifelse(levels(lines$who) == "West Sussex", "longdash", ifelse(levels(lines$who) %in% names(FIXED), "solid", "dotted")))), levels(lines$who))
g <- function(d, st, sec, yr, v) d[stage == st & sector == sec & year == yr][[v]]
m_now <- function(v, st = "All", d = area) g(d, st, "Maintained", LAT_M, v)
rank_def <- S[level == "Authority" & stage == "All" & sector == "Maintained" & year == LAT_M & schools >= 10][
  order(-deficit_pct)][, r := seq_len(.N)]
n_auth <- nrow(rank_def); my_rank <- rank_def[unit == AREA, r]
yr_x <- function(y) as.integer(substr(y, 1, 4))
FC <- tryCatch(readRDS(here::here("data", "finance_closures.rds")), error = function(e) NULL)
DEM <- tryCatch(readRDS(here::here("data", "demographics.rds")), error = function(e) NULL)
dem <- if (!is.null(DEM) && LEVEL == "Authority") DEM$trend[level == "Local authority" & area == AREA] else NULL
peak_def <- area[stage == "All" & sector == "Maintained"][which.max(deficit_pct)]
pr <- S[level == "Authority" & stage == "All" & sector == "Maintained" & year == peak_def$year & schools >= 10][order(-deficit_pct)][, r := seq_len(.N)]
rk_txt <- function(r, n, tail = "", what = "authorities") {   # the bottom quarter is counted from the bottom
  lo <- r > 0.75 * n; k <- if (lo) n - r + 1 else r
  paste0(if (k == 1) "the " else paste0("the ", ord(k), " "), if (lo) "lowest" else "highest", " of ", n, " ", what, tail)
}
# Fewer than MIN schools: no share, median or line is shown for that phase and year (one
# school's figures are its own, and a share of two or three schools says little).
MIN <- 5
lines <- lines[!(who == AREA & schools < MIN)]
n_m <- m_now("schools"); n_m <- if (length(n_m)) n_m else 0L
HAS_M <- n_m >= MIN
n_sec <- m_now("schools", "Secondary"); n_sec <- if (length(n_sec)) n_sec else 0L
acad_pp <- function(d) 100 * g(d, "All", "Academy", LAT_A, "pupils") / g(d, "All", "All", LAT_A, "pupils")
n_all <- g(area, "All", "All", LAT_A, "schools")
area_m <- area[stage == "All" & sector == "Maintained" & schools >= MIN]
if (nrow(area_m)) peak_def <- area_m[which.max(deficit_pct)]
pr <- S[level == "Authority" & stage == "All" & sector == "Maintained" & year == peak_def$year & schools >= 10][order(-deficit_pct)][, r := seq_len(.N)]
peak_rank <- if (LEVEL == "Authority" && AREA %in% pr$unit) rk_txt(pr[unit == AREA, r], nrow(pr), " that year") else
  paste0("against ", pts(eng[stage == "All" & sector == "Maintained" & year == peak_def$year, deficit_pct], 0), "% in England")
# Districts: ranked among the Sussex districts with at least MIN maintained schools
rank_dist <- S[level == "District" & stage == "All" & sector == "Maintained" & year == LAT_M & schools >= MIN][
  order(-deficit_pct)][, r := seq_len(.N)]
rank_line <- if (LEVEL == "Authority" && length(my_rank)) paste0("That is ", rk_txt(my_rank, n_auth), ".") else
  if (LEVEL == "District" && AREA %in% rank_dist$unit) paste0("That is ", rk_txt(rank_dist[unit == AREA, r], nrow(rank_dist),
    " with at least five maintained schools", "Sussex districts"), ".") else ""
page_of <- function(x) paste0(gsub("[^a-z]+", "_", tolower(x)), ".html")
```

      if (r21$schools != n_m) paste0(" (when ", r21$schools, " schools were maintained)") else "") else "",

  "% of England's in ", LAT_A, " (all state mainstream schools)."))
if (!is.null(dem) && nrow(dem)) b <- c(b, paste0("- **Rolls are falling.** Primary-age pupils are ", pts(abs(dem$primary_chg), 0),
  "% down since ", yl(DEM$t0), ", and the Year 7 intake will be about ", pts(abs(dem$y7_chg_2032), 0),

:::

These pages describe Hastings' schools as a whole, from DfE's published
finance returns. As on [School finances before closure](../finance.qmd), no
open school is named. Maintained schools report every year from 2014-15 to
2025-26 (Consistent Financial Reporting, April to March); academies from 2016-17
to 2024-25 (Academy Accounts Returns, September to August). An academy in a
multi-academy trust reports only its own share of reserves, without the trust's
central reserve, and some trusts report none (nearly a third of academy returns
show a reserve of exactly zero), so **the reserve series below are for maintained
schools** unless marked. A share, median or line needs at least five schools behind
it, so phases and years with fewer are left out.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-schools
#| tbl-cap: !expr paste0("State mainstream schools in ", AREA, " with a finance return, by phase and sector, in the latest year of each (maintained ", LAT_M, ", academies ", LAT_A, ").")
tb <- rbind(area[sector == "Maintained" & year == LAT_M & stage != "All"], area[sector == "Academy" & year == LAT_A & stage != "All"])
few5 <- function(n, x) ifelse(n < MIN, "–", x)   # fewer than five schools: counted, not described
tb[, .(Phase = stage, Sector = sector, Year = year, Schools = schools, Pupils = few5(schools, format(round(pupils), big.mark = ",")),
       `In deficit` = few5(schools, ifelse(sector == "Academy", "see note", paste0(round(deficit_pct), "%"))),
       `Median reserve, % of income` = few5(schools, ifelse(sector == "Academy", "see note", sprintf("%.1f", med_reserve))),
       `Income per pupil` = few5(schools, paste0("£", format(round(income_pp), big.mark = ","))))] |> kt(align = "lllrrrrr")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bands
#| eval: !expr HAS_M
#| include: !expr HAS_M
#| tbl-cap: !expr paste0("How maintained schools' revenue reserves are spread in ", LAT_M, ", as the number of schools in each band of reserve as a share of income in ", AREA, ", and the share of England's schools in each band.")
B <- A$bands[sector == "Maintained" & stage %in% c("Primary", "Secondary")]
ba <- B[unit == AREA & level == LEVEL] |> dcast(band ~ stage, value.var = "schools", fill = 0)
be <- B[unit == "England"][, pct := 100 * schools / sum(schools), by = stage] |> dcast(band ~ stage, value.var = "pct", fill = 0)
out <- merge(data.table(band = factor(A$band_labels, A$band_labels)), ba, by = "band", all.x = TRUE) |>
  merge(be, by = "band", all.x = TRUE, suffixes = c("", "_eng"))
for (v in names(out)[-1]) set(out, which(is.na(out[[v]])), v, 0)
few <- function(v) if (sum(v) < MIN) rep("–", length(v)) else as.character(v)   # fewer than five schools: not shown
out[, .(`Reserve, % of income` = band, `Primary schools` = few(Primary), `England primary` = sprintf("%.0f%%", Primary_eng),
        `Secondary schools` = if ("Secondary" %in% names(out)) few(Secondary) else "–",
        `England secondary` = if ("Secondary_eng" %in% names(out)) sprintf("%.0f%%", Secondary_eng) else "")] |>
  kt(align = "lrrrr")
```

## Across Sussex {#sec-sussex}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sussex
#| tbl-cap: !expr paste0("Sussex's thirteen districts compared. Schools and the share of pupils in academies, ", LAT_A, " (all state mainstream schools); maintained schools in deficit and their median reserve as % of income, ", LAT_M, " (where there are at least five); income per pupil against England, ", LAT_A, "; and open schools in the early-warning band or with three or more warning signs. Each district links to its page.")
D <- S[level == "District" & stage == "All"]
ue <- g(eng, "All", "All", LAT_A, "income_pp")
W <- if (!is.null(A$warn_district)) A$warn_district[, .(flagged = sum(flagged), three = sum(three_plus)), by = .(unit = area)] else
  data.table(unit = character(), flagged = integer(), three = integer())
tb <- U[level == "District", .(unit, parent)] |>
  merge(D[sector == "All" & year == LAT_A, .(unit, n = schools, tp = pupils, ipp = 100 * income_pp / ue)], by = "unit", all.x = TRUE) |>
  merge(D[sector == "Academy" & year == LAT_A, .(unit, ap = pupils)], by = "unit", all.x = TRUE) |>
  merge(D[sector == "Maintained" & year == LAT_M, .(unit, nm = schools, def = deficit_pct, med = med_reserve)], by = "unit", all.x = TRUE) |>
  merge(W, by = "unit", all.x = TRUE)
tb <- tb[order(parent != "Brighton and Hove", parent, unit)]
tb[is.na(nm), nm := 0L]
out <- tb[, .(District = ifelse(unit == AREA, unit, paste0('<a href="', page_of(unit), '">', unit, '</a>')),
              Authority = parent, Schools = n, `Pupils in academies` = paste0(round(100 * fcoalesce(ap, 0) / tp), "%"),
              `Maintained schools` = nm,
              `In deficit` = ifelse(nm >= MIN, paste0(round(def), "%"), "–"),
              `Median reserve` = ifelse(nm >= MIN, sprintf("%.1f%%", med), "–"),
              `Income per pupil, England = 100` = round(ipp),
              `In warning band` = fcoalesce(flagged, 0L), `Three or more signs` = fcoalesce(three, 0L))]
hl <- which(tb$unit == AREA | (LEVEL == "Authority" & tb$parent == AREA))
k <- kt(out, align = "llrrrrrrrr", escape = FALSE)
if (length(hl)) k <- kableExtra::row_spec(k, hl, bold = TRUE, background = "#eedeff")
k
```

`r if (LEVEL == "Authority" && AREA != "Brighton and Hove") paste0(POSS, " districts are shaded. ") else ""`Each school is
placed in a district by its location. In most districts the maintained schools are a
minority, so the academy column shows how much of the picture the reserve figures cover:
in a district where most pupils are in academies, the maintained schools that remain are
often the smaller ones. Brighton and Hove is both a district and an authority.

## Data and notes {#sec-area-fin-data}

DfE's [Financial Benchmarking and Insights
Tool](https://financial-benchmarking-and-insights-tool.education.gov.uk/data-sources)
files, as on [School finances before closure](../finance.qmd#sec-fin-data):
Consistent Financial Reporting for maintained schools (financial years 2014-15 to
2025-26) and Academy Accounts Returns for academies (2016-17 to 2024-25), for state
mainstream primary, middle, secondary and all-through schools. A school is in deficit
when its revenue reserve at year end is below zero; the in-year balance is total income
less total expenditure. Sums are over the schools with a return that year; medians and
shares are of schools, not pupils. Income per pupil is the area's total income over its
total pupils (full-time equivalent). Figures are in cash terms; comparing with England
each year removes inflation. Shares, medians and lines need at least five schools behind
them. Schools are placed in a Sussex district by their location (GIAS easting and
northing, nearest ONS district boundary); the district warning-sign counts come from the
same open-school list as the authority counts, counted by district.
Built by `R/44_area_finance.R` (data/area_finance.rds) and `R/45_finance_pages.R`.
